title: Change warm red background/theme to calm green

requirements.text: Update the site color theme so the current warm/red-leaning background and accents are replaced with a calm green palette (matching the referenced Funngro teen page vibe), without changing page content or layout.

quotes: instead of ward red backround can you add calm green as in the website

acceptanceCriteria: Primary brand color (buttons, links, highlights) renders as a calm green instead of coral/red.
Page background and gradient hero backgrounds no longer appear warm red/pink; they should read as neutral + calm green accents.
Muted section backgrounds (e.g., Section variant="muted") remain subtle and readable with the updated palette.
No changes to marketing copy, routing, or component structure; only styling/theme values change.

requirements.text: Implement the calm green palette by updating the CSS theme tokens used by Tailwind (OKLCH variables) in frontend/src/index.css, including light and dark mode values for background, primary, secondary, accent, ring, and any related chart/shadow tokens that currently bias warm red/orange.

quotes: instead of ward red backround can you add calm green as in the website

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/index.css updates the :root and .dark token set so --primary/--accent/--ring (and any other warm-biased tokens) are green-toned.
Interactive focus rings and outlines (ring utilities) visually match the new calm green theme.
Any existing warm-themed shadow token(s) (e.g., warm glow) are updated to a green-compatible equivalent or removed if unused, with no visual regressions (no harsh/oversaturated green casts).

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (shadcn components are read-only).
Do not edit any frontend immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Keep all changes limited to frontend styling/theme; no backend changes.
nonGoals: Adding new sections (e.g., contact), changing SEO metadata, or updating marketing copy.
